model: Acuvim II with AXM-BIP BACnet IP module
equipment_type: Power and energy meter (BACnet IP module)
applies_to: Accuenergy Acuvim II series power meters fitted with the AXM-BIP BACnet IP communication module, with or without AXM-IO modules.
summary: The AXM-BIP clips onto an Acuvim II power meter and serves its readings over BACnet IP with no mapping needed. It exposes 71 metering Analog Inputs (voltage, current, power, demand, energy, THD), plus Binary Inputs, analog-input values and pulse counters for any AXM-IO modules fitted. Everything is read-only.
notes: The manual has no access column; all objects are measurements or input states and are listed here as read-only.
BI 1-28, AI 1001-1008 and AI 2001-2028 only carry data when the matching AXM-IO module (IO11, IO21, IO31, IO12, IO22, IO32) is installed.

The manual prints 'Average Line Voltage' for both AI 5 and AI 9, and 'Phase B Export Active Energy' for both AI 51 and AI 52. By position, AI 5 is probably the average phase voltage and AI 51 the phase B import energy; check on site.
AI 42 and AI 43 (reactive energy) are printed with kWh units; reactive energy is normally kvarh.
Power factor objects (AI 27-30) and Load Type (AI 33) have no units in the table.
The manual's intro says the AXM-BIP tracks 78 measurements and 28 I/O values; its table lists 71 metering AIs.

source.title: BACnet for Acuvim II Series Power Meter, User's Manual

integration.summary: Set the meter's second serial port to 38400 baud, 8N1 and protocol 'Other', give the AXM-BIP an IP address from the front panel, then set the device instance and UDP port in its web page. Read total power, imported energy, demand, power factor, current and voltage.
setup: On the meter set S03 BPS2 = 38400, S31 Parity2 = 1NO and S34 Protocol 2 = Other; IP settings are on the NET pages (N02-N06), then reset with N09 NET REST.

BACnet settings are in the module web page (Settings > Communications > BACnet-IP, default admin password 'admin'): enable BACnet, UDP port (default 47808), device instance, network ID and device name.
Foreign device registration to a BBMD is supported (BBMD IP, port, time to live 5-1440 min).
Reset the module after any network or BACnet change.
gotchas: Duplicate names at AI 5/AI 9 and AI 51/AI 52; map by instance, not by name.
I/O module objects read nothing unless that AXM-IO module is fitted.
Change the default web password; the web page controls the BACnet settings.
